definition: LlamaIndex is an American artificial intelligence company headquartered in San Francisco, California.
details: LlamaIndex specializes in agentic optical character recognition (OCR) and document intelligence infrastructure, developing tools and frameworks that enable large language models (LLMs) to ingest, index, and query structured and unstructured data sources.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is LlamaIndex.
